cohort: 209 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered at a specialized center between November 2009 and May 2012
finding: Although postpartum glucose abnormalities were frequent in women with GDM, postpartum diabetes screening rates were low, and persistent hyperglycemia was associated with family history of diabetes, higher 2-h OGTT during pregnancy, insulin use during pregnancy, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with persistent hyperglycemia postpartum (RR 2.61, p=0.015).
